scopeAdjustment.rule: Only scopes above five documents change. Keep every expected/evidence document; fill with original-scope distractors sharing an evidence document topic, then fill in original order. No-answer cases have no evidence topic and retain the first five original documents. Preserve original order within the final scope.

measurement.warmup: First query of each mode in each JVM is executed once without recording time.
measurement.scope: Per-question selected documents, at most five. Not unrestricted search across all 27 documents.
measurement.timing: Starts after per-question scope selection. Includes lexical ranking; hybrid also includes loopback HTTP embedding, in-memory vector search, RRF and section diversification. Excludes scope filtering, indexing, SQL and answer generation.
measurement.noAnswer: Nonempty candidate retrieval on labeled no-answer cases; not an answer-generation hallucination rate.
measurement.baseline: Both modes rerun after scope correction; previous broader-scope lexical scores are not this baseline.
